scientific_integrity: The proof is combinatorial and all-size; exact computational verification of finite sizes is supplementary and does not independently certify the universal theorem. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary strict-neighbor majority, tie retention, square rook graphs; fixed states only. The \(2^n\) count is modulo independent row and column permutations, not transposition. The earlier 302 count for the 4-by-4 rook graph is acknowledged. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is uncertain; independent mathematical audit not conducted.
title: A power-of-two classification of majority equilibria on square rook graphs
